description: This file is the main activity class for an Android messaging service app. It extends android.app.Activity and sets up the initial UI, including adding a MessagingFragment to the container view if there is no saved state.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity extends Activity and initializes the UI for the messaging app by inflating the layout and adding a MessagingFragment if appropriate.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Called when the activity is starting. Sets the content view and adds MessagingFragment if there is no saved instance state.
